entries.description: Read, create, update, and analyze tasks in GSD Task Manager from any MCP-aware assistant.
representativeQueries: add a task to my Eisenhower matrix
what are my urgent and important tasks
which tasks are due this week
mark my top task as done
how is my work spread across the four quadrants

entries.description: Drop a single new task into GSD Task Manager and place it in the right Eisenhower quadrant.
representativeQueries: remind me to renew my passport
add a task to call the dentist tomorrow
capture this as an urgent task

entries.description: Walk the user through their open tasks and move them into the correct quadrant.
representativeQueries: what should I work on next
review my open tasks and sort them into quadrants
